text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026 - Canary failures detected (eu-west-2)

carol (oncall): seeing the PD page, joining. any initial scope?

ben (sre): p95 spike and 503s on embed endpoints for canary instances only. metrics: embed-requests.errored +12% in last 2m.

alice (eng-oncall): exact deploy? who rolled the canary?

dylan (platform): rollout v2.1.7 -> canary weight 5% in eu-west-2, commit 9f3a2b. Changed tokenizer pipeline and quant path.

carol (oncall): ok marking impact: degraded embed generation for a subset of canary hosts, potential customer impact if traffic routed to those hosts.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026 acknowledged by carol (oncall)

carol (oncall): assigning to ben for triage, alice for deploy/rollback coordination.

ben (sre): looking at logs, getting repeated: 
```
2026-06-03T12:45:12Z ERROR embed-service request failed status=503 err="kvcache miss + tokenization overflow"
```
Pattern ties to tokenizer changes — token length check failing on some inputs, raising exception that surfaces as 503.

dylan (platform): quick-check: can we hit healthcheck on canary pods? curl command: `curl -sS http://canary-eu-west-2.embed/healthz`

alice (eng-oncall): trying a single request to reproduce with typical user prompt from telemetry.```
# reproduce
curl -X POST http://canary-eu-west-2.embed/generate -d '{"text":"<long prompt with emojis and mixed unicode>"}'
```
Got 503 locally, reproduces.

carol (oncall): customer-facing impact? eve? any support tickets?

eve (support): no widespread tickets yet. A couple of dev customers in eu-west-2 reported intermittent 503s ~12:44-12:47. Most on early-adopter/dev tiers.

ben (sre): mitigation options: 1) immediate rollback of canary to previous image 2) scale canary to 0 (stop routing) 3) push hotfix to tokenizer. Fastest is rollback or stop traffic routing.

alice (eng-oncall): prefer rollback of canary to be safe. dylan, can you set rollout weight 0 for v2.1.7 canary? Config is in rollout service. snippet:```
rollout: {
  model: "embed-service",
  region: "eu-west-2",
  traffic: [{version: "v2.1.7", weight: 0}, {version: "v2.1.6", weight: 100}]
}
```

dylan (platform): on it. Running `rdwctl rollout update --region eu-west-2 --service embed-service --version v2.1.6 --weight 100`

dylan (platform): done — confirmation: canary weight set to 0, routing reverted to v2.1.6.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback event recorded (rollback-id rlbk-4490001234-1)

carol (oncall): monitoring ingress errors and customer tickets. Ben, can you confirm errors stop?

ben (sre): watching graphs — error rate returned to baseline within 45s of the rollback. p95 latency also normalized. No new 503s for 3m.

eve (support): pinging impacted customers with a short note: we briefly observed degraded responses in eu-west-2; traffic served from fallback version; let us know if you still see issues.

alice (eng-oncall): good. we should keep the incident open for postmortem and RCA. immediate mitigation worked. Next steps: gather logs, tokenization failure repro, and prepare a safe-hotfix plan (add defensive token-length check).

carol (oncall): agreed. opening temporary incident channel for followup and linking runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/canary-failure

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026 status set to "Resolved" by carol (oncall) after rollback and validation

ben (sre): leaving notes: affected hosts: canary-{a3,a5,a7}; error fingerprint: `tokenization overflow -> panic -> 503` ; sample stack: `tokenizer.cpp:412 handle_overflow()`

dylan (platform): add follow-ups: add autosafe check in rollout service to reject versions that increase tokenization limit without backward compat flag.

alice (eng-oncall): creating a postmortem ticket: PM-4490001234 with owner ben. Tasks:
- collect traces + sample requests 12:40-12:50 (ben)
- reproduce locally and add unit test for the edge case (alice)
- autosafe rollout guard (dylan)
- customer comms follow-up (eve)

carol (oncall): handing incident to morning oncall for full postmortem. tagging @ben to lead.

ben (sre): ack; will draft RCA.

incident-bot: Note: incident channel will be archived after postmortem complete.

carol (oncall): closing the active page, keep the thread for postmortem updates. :thumbsup:
